label.zh: 带着凯德斯进入第一个地点系统（火山行星），先后顺序不限
label.en: Enter the first location system (volcanic planet) with Keides aboard; any order

bridges.evidence: events/paragon_events_3.txt:2264-2290 / 2386-2412 / 2504-2530: ship_event fired by on_entering_system (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:960-962) when a fleet carrying a leader with leader_trait_legendary_far_from_home enters the flagged system for the first time; flag legendary_leader_1st_system, country flag leader_visited_1st_system

label.zh: 带着凯德斯进入第二个地点系统（舰船坟场），先后顺序不限
label.en: Enter the second location system (ship graveyard) with Keides aboard; any order

bridges.evidence: events/paragon_events_3.txt:2264-2290 / 2386-2412 / 2504-2530: ship_event fired by on_entering_system (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:960-962) when a fleet carrying a leader with leader_trait_legendary_far_from_home enters the flagged system for the first time; flag legendary_leader_2nd_system, leader_visited_2nd_system

label.zh: 带着凯德斯进入第三个地点系统（丛林敌对行星），先后顺序不限
label.en: Enter the third location system (hostile jungle planet) with Keides aboard; any order

bridges.evidence: events/paragon_events_3.txt:2264-2290 / 2386-2412 / 2504-2530: ship_event fired by on_entering_system (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:960-962) when a fleet carrying a leader with leader_trait_legendary_far_from_home enters the flagged system for the first time; flag legendary_leader_3rd_system, leader_visited_3rd_system

label.zh: 通过虫洞抵达终点系统（苏尔瑟克特）时
label.en: On arriving through the wormhole at the final system (Sursect)

bridges.evidence: paragon.3141 spawns natural wormholes linked to the legendary_leader_final_system (events/paragon_events_3.txt:2736-2805); paragon.3144 is a ship_event from on_entering_system_first_time (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:935) requiring FROM has_star_flag legendary_leader_final_system and a leader with leader_trait_legendary_far_from_home (2827-2845)

label.zh: 或者以武力击毁无人机舰队
label.en: Or destroy the drone fleet by force

bridges.evidence: paragon.3149 fires from on_fleet_destroyed_perp (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1670) when the destroyed fleet carries overlord_enforcers_automated_fleet (events/paragon_events_3.txt:2972-2996); it aborts the sabotage project; the fleet is created by common/solar_system_initializers/paragon_initializers.txt:796

note.zh: 三处地点没有固定先后；每处各做一次专项并看到幻视，三处都完成（事件链计数 planets_studied）后触发“复原遗物”。
note.en: The three sites have no fixed order; each is studied once with its project and vision, and when all three are done (event-chain counter planets_studied) the relic is restored.

label.zh: 对付无人机的三种方式
label.en: Three ways to deal with the drones

note.zh: 电磁脉冲（保留钥匙）/ 交出钥匙（遗物失去）/ 武力击毁，三者互相替代。
note.en: Electromagnetic pulse (keep the Key) / hand over the Key (relic lost) / destroy them by force; these are alternatives.

notes.zh: 评注：故事的最后一站——终点星系里的星球是考古遗址“传奇领袖故乡”，由 site-paragon-legendary-leader-homeworld（C2）收录。
notes.en: Commentary: the last stop — the planet in the final system is the archaeological site "Legendary Leader homeworld", covered by site-paragon-legendary-leader-homeworld (C2).

notes.zh: 评注：触发地点是银河生成时标记了 legendary_leader_spawn_system 的星系；任一舰队首次进入且尚无人找到冷冻舱（全局旗标 frozen_legendary_leader_found）时触发。
notes.en: Commentary: the location is the system flagged legendary_leader_spawn_system at galaxy generation; the first fleet to enter it while nobody has found the capsule (global flag frozen_legendary_leader_found) triggers it.

notes.zh: 评注：养育选项按帝国伦理出现，选择会设下全局旗标 leader_raised_*，影响之后凯德斯的特质（events/paragon_events_3.txt:1906-1961）。
notes.en: Commentary: the upbringing options appear by empire ethic and set global flags leader_raised_* that shape Keides' traits later (events/paragon_events_3.txt:1906-1961).

scope.zh: 从求救信号到终点星系的整条线、三个幻视地点的并行关系、无人机三种对策都已核对；终点遗址属 C2。
scope.en: The whole line from the distress signal to the final system, the parallel vision sites and the three answers to the drones were checked; the final site belongs to C2.

uncertain: Which of the three vision systems is assigned to which flag (1st/2nd/3rd) is set at galaxy generation by the initializers; their placement was not traced.
Option-level text variants of 3105/3114 are shown by the reader's generic condition model.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this star system appears here.
